decisions.why: FR-010 and amendment 1 ('Refuse writes to the tree while your own gate runs'); each refused write moves HEAD or a tracked file that preflight.py --tree-check hashes, so each voids the gate - enforcement of what was asked.

decisions.summary: git add is let through while the gate runs, on the premise that it moves nothing the gate checks
decisions.why: The premise is false, measured 2026-10-17 by this reviewer: preflight.py tree() keys on `git diff --name-only HEAD`, and in a scratch repo `git add` of an untracked file made it appear in that list (before: empty; after: 'new'), so tree_moved() reports it and the gate goes NOT GREEN. Staging a new file is the ordinary step before a commit, so the carve-out passes exactly the gate-voiding write FR-010 exists to stop (purpose-fatal). The earlier CLEAR text refused git add. Fix: refuse a git add that stages any path not already in `git diff --name-only HEAD` (a new file), or refuse git add whole; a git add of an already-modified tracked file may pass.

decisions.summary: make record-checked and make modal-triaged are let through as writing only under .git/
decisions.why: Adjudicated per target. modal-triaged: within - modal_triage.py record writes the store and its TOUCHED mark only, under .git/. record-checked: the premise is false for one of its forms - with REPLY= it runs record_owed.file_outside(), which appends to the active feature's specs/<NNN>/found.jsonl, a TRACKED file (git ls-files lists specs/335-.../found.jsonl and others), so it moves the tracked tree and voids the gate. (REASON= writes a new untracked file under dev/bypass-log/, which tree() does not see.) Fix: refuse make record-checked when REPLY= is given (or move found.jsonl writes to wait), and state the premise per form rather than for the target.

decisions.summary: FR-003: opt-in plan line; make tick refuses a task whose Approach block is missing or answers fewer items
decisions.why: Request: 'make tick refuses until it's answered'; FR-003/FR-001 carry the opt-in and its later extension.

decisions.summary: FR-004 triggers: arbiter hour/red-gate ruling, a cohort seed newly refused (seeds failing at HEAD fire nothing), a re-review of Decisions after CLEAR
decisions.why: Request names 'the first seed the change refuses, a second red gate, or the hourly step-back'; a seed already failing at HEAD is not refused by the change, so the floor is the clause's own scope, not a carve-out. Re-decide trigger is FR-004 verbatim.

decisions.why: Amendment 1 item 4 and FR-005/FR-011 as written; the source choice is implementation.

decisions.summary: FR-008: triage answers keep the blobs they read; triage bundle groups units by baseline; claims triage the same
decisions.why: FR-008 covers pop-ups and claims re-owed by a page change, triaged against what the last check read; measured cause recorded.

decisions.summary: FR-009: record-owed marks answered/owed; #unfootnoted in one batch; modal-bundle takes several KINDs in one bundle
decisions.why: Amendment 1 item 2: one quote-check batch for a page-wide check, one agent for the pop-ups a changed page re-owes; the listing fix removes the measured cause of the extra batches.

decisions.summary: FR-010: guard refuses, while this tree's make done runs, Edit/Write into the clone, git commit, git add, and the tracked-record targets (append, claims-checked, claims-triaged, record-checked, tick, accept), naming make verify-wait; only make modal-triaged (writes under .git/ only) passes; both round-2 refusals in the test
decisions.why: Request: 'Refuse writes to the tree while your own gate runs'. git add and record-checked REPLY= both move what the gate's tree() compares, so refusing them is the asked enforcement, not unrequested reach. modal-triaged writes nothing the tree check sees, so passing it is outside the rule rather than an exception to it. Round 2's finding is resolved.

decisions.summary: The hourly clock subtracts GM waits (gm field on prompts); report's 'waiting: the GM' reads it
decisions.why: The round arbiter's tooling fix on hour:385@4, binding by feature 379; it makes the existing hourly trigger FR-004 extends measure the session's time.
